scope: Read-only source/design review. No source edit, Cargo, Windows, CI or network performed. Creates only this independent report and SHA sidecar in outer evidence. Core module only; no startup/MSI integration or full owner claim.

facts.subject: identity and namespace
facts.fact: Production identity has private fields, OS KnownFolder LocalAppData, process token SID, fixed family/root leaf; service SIDs refused. Native path rejects nonfixed drives, nonabsolute path, reparse points, trailing aliases and length overflow; ancestors retained without DELETE sharing.

facts.subject: physical ownership
facts.fact: Startup read/share-read gate and maintenance read-write/share0 use same fixed physical gate. Any Pending presence or inaccessible marker refuses, without stale-record recovery. Gate and regular Pending verify one hardlink, owner and exact protected current-SID+SYSTEM DACL.

facts.subject: Pending
facts.fact: Create-new same original handle, <=4096 bytes, nonce/family/operation/SID, checked write count, FlushFileBuffers and exact inode/ACL/size/readback. Drop does not explicitly clear Pending.

facts.subject: guardian and settlement
facts.fact: DuplicateHandle pins retained Child process object. Actual process token SID, child PID and creation FILETIME bound; original handle must be signaled with exit0. Trusted Settlement checks operation/guardian/Join0/End0/effects; it is explicitly not authenticated IPC.

facts.subject: deadline and bounded ownership
facts.fact: Original Instant deadline is retained, checked at entry and after Pending creation; no renewal. Fixed 8-claim x64-handle retention ledger, sticky process FAULTED, no replacement handles or new pool/thread in production source.

facts.subject: child selection
facts.fact: Exact child selector installer_lifecycle::tests::native_child matches public module path. Child uses current test executable, --exact and --test-threads=1, original retained Child and bounded polling. Only that child test runs in child; it does not recursively execute parent scenarios. Prefix length31 plus32hex agrees with asserted leaf length63. No Windows tests were run by reviewer.

issues.title: Late cleanup/close failure can lose durable negative state after process exit
issues.sourceFacts: clear_pending marks the original Pending delete-pending and closes it before release closes Parent and Gate handles. If Pending close or any later Parent/Gate close fails, the process is faulted and raw capabilities retained, but Pending is either already absent or remains delete-pending and is deleted when OS closes it at process exit. No durable fallback negative record is written.
issues.consequence: In the stated late-close-failure scenario, a subsequent process can recreate/open the gate and observe Pending absent after the failed owner exits. Process-local FAULTED/ledger do not survive that exit, violating the design requirement that cleanup error/owner loss remains blocked across restart.
issues.validationStatus: STATIC_CONTROL_FLOW; no actual CloseHandle failure observed. Existing fail_close test injects failure only into StartupLease before cleanup, so does not exercise this maintenance deletion/late-close path.
issues.suggestedResolution: Keep a durable negative indication through all failure-prone release stages, including deletion-disposition/late-close errors; exercise role-specific Pending/Parent/Gate close refusal in isolated maintenance children and then restart another process to assert it remains blocked.

issues.title: LocalAppData ACL acceptance omits FILE_DELETE_CHILD
issues.sourceFacts: The non-exact LocalAppData dangerous access mask includes DELETE/WRITE_DAC/WRITE_OWNER and several write bits, but not FILE_DELETE_CHILD (0x40). An otherwise valid allow ACE for an untrusted ordinary SID granting only that directory right passes the mask test.
issues.consequence: Ancestor pins prevent rename while live; after owner death, parent DELETE_CHILD can authorize removal/rename of the fixed coordination child despite that child having a protected DACL. Renaming the whole root into another same-volume writable parent can move Pending away, allowing fresh empty root creation and loss of durable negative state.
issues.validationStatus: SOURCE_MASK_DEFECT; permission/rename counterexample has not been run on Windows.
issues.suggestedResolution: Include FILE_DELETE_CHILD in rejected untrusted effective parent grants, and verify with an isolated test directory/allow ACE. Do not modify actual LocalAppData ACL to test.

issues.title: Hardlink rejection test can abort during unwind and leave its namespace
issues.sourceFacts: gate-alias is removed only after all rejection assertions. If an assertion fails first, Fixture::drop removes only ready/pending.v1/gate.lock, then remove_dir(...).expect fails because gate-alias remains. This panics while already unwinding.
issues.consequence: The test executable can abort rather than report the original failed assertion, and the random owned namespace/alias remains, contrary to required test cleanup.
issues.validationStatus: STATIC_FAILURE_PATH; normal successful path cleanup is correct.
issues.suggestedResolution: Give the exact owned alias a cleanup guard created immediately after hard_link, so it is removed before Fixture drops on every path. Preserve original failure without a second panic during unwinding.

notIssuesOrClaims: No source-proven child filter mismatch was found; zero-test execution remains something the root runner should observe in its actual output, not a finding asserted here.
Process SID is used rather than a thread impersonation token; no impersonating integration exists in this slice, so no demonstrated impersonation exploit is claimed.
No actual linker, executable, cross-process gate, reboot, MSI, Win7/Win10/Win11 runtime or Seewo result is inferred from this source review.
